notes: kb/Work PB5923 (closed by step 1 of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §1985:X.3.1.4 GR1: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program." The source and object program half holds as before (BinderDriver.MakeUnit takes the name from PROGRAM-ID; ProgramTable.CallProgram/ResolveVisible find the object program by it, contained programs included). The listing half now holds for a contained program: ProgramRangeBuilder.Build gives each listing line the INNERMOST program that contains it, so a page whose first line lies in a nested program names the nested program (TextListingRenderer.IdentificationLine); the witness forces pages inside the nested program and checks every heading against the program ranges read from the source text.

next.reason: 1985: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program."; 2023: "Program-name-1 names the program declared by this program definition. Literal-1, if specified, is the name of the program that is externalized". 2023 no longer says program-name identifies the object program and listings. When literal-1 is given, the name externalized to the operating environment is literal-1, not program-name.
